text: 在11月3日举行的2026年四季度环球市场纵览暨主动ETF研讨会上，摩根资产管理资深环球市场策略师朱超平指出，当前全球来看制造业与服务业PMI总体处于扩张区间，服务业强于制造业，区域分化延续；美国通胀逐步回落，美联储后续利率路径仍是影响全球资产定价的关键变量。此外，全球AI资本开支前景受到投资者关注，但不同行业的商业化应用渗透并不均衡，需要甄别企业投资真实落地情况与利润兑现能力。从资产配置来看，60/40股债模拟组合框架仍长期具备参考意义。
text_en: At the 2026 Q4 Global Market Outlook and Active ETF Seminar held on November 3, Zhu Chaoping, senior global market strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset Management, noted that globally, manufacturing and services PMIs are generally in expansion territory, with services stronger than manufacturing and regional divergence continuing; US inflation is gradually falling, and the Fed's subsequent rate path remains a key variable for global asset pricing. In addition, investors are focused on the outlook for global AI capital expenditure, but commercialization penetration varies across industries, requiring scrutiny of whether corporate investment is truly materializing and whether profits are being delivered. On asset allocation, the 60/40 stock-bond model portfolio framework still has long-term reference value.
